findings.message: `$@` is unquoted, so filenames with spaces are split and wildcard characters can expand before `lk_check_files` receives them. Pass `"$@"` to preserve each filename as one argument.
Invalid `-n` values are usage errors per the README conventions, but this exits 1 without printing the command usage. Use `lk_usage_error number ...` so the command reports usage and exits 2.
